items.text:
Created [ADD-001 architecture and readiness matrix](/tmp/dfai-architecture-eval-qg0aqo4b/project/docs/specs/add/ADD-001.md) and three supporting ADRs.

- **Ready for epic definition:** FR-002 booking, FR-003 roster, and all three NFRs.
- **Blocked:** FR-001 sign-in needs an identity-provider and enrollment decision. Booking and roster delivery still depend on sign-in.

The design specifies hosted services, transactional booking, revocable sessions, and coordinator-only phone access.

Document checks passed; runtime tests are **NOT_RUN** because no implementation exists. The approved PRD remains unchanged.
